summary.zh-CN: 上传 PR 差异、提交记录与 Issue 即可开始：带行号的 PR 评审意见（区分阻断与建议）、发布说明草案、Issue 分诊与追问，附安全修复验证与安全设计评审；不替你评论、合并、推送、发版或关闭 Issue。
summary.en: Start from uploaded PR diffs, commit logs and issues: line-referenced PR review comments separating blocking from suggestions, release note drafts, issue triage with follow-up questions, plus security fix verification and security design review; it never comments, merges, pushes, releases or closes issues for you.

now.zh-CN: 按正确性、测试、安全、可维护性逐处评审 PR 差异，每条意见带文件行号并区分阻断、建议与提问
now.en: Review PR diffs for correctness, tests, security and maintainability, with file and line on every comment, separated into blocking, suggestion and question

now.zh-CN: 给出建议批准、建议请求变更或需人工复核三种结论之一，不代替批准
now.en: Give one of three conclusions — suggest approve, suggest request changes, or needs manual review — without approving for you

now.zh-CN: 从已合并 PR 或提交记录整理发布说明，不兼容变更附升级步骤，每条附来源编号
now.en: Draft release notes from merged PRs or commits, with upgrade steps for breaking changes and a source reference on every line

now.zh-CN: 对 Issue 判定类型、优先级建议、缺失信息与疑似重复，并起草追问
now.en: Triage issues by type, suggested priority, missing information and suspected duplicates, and draft follow-up questions

now.zh-CN: 在对话中使用（无任务模板）：核对安全修复是否闭环，并按 OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 章节评审设计文档
now.en: Use in conversation (no task template): verify that security fixes close the original finding, and review design documents against OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 chapters

needs.zh-CN: PR 差异与描述、版本区间内的已合并 PR 或提交记录、Issue 文本
needs.en: PR diffs and descriptions, merged PRs or commits for the release range, and issue text

needs.zh-CN: 可选：团队评审规范、优先级定义、迁移文档、组件关注人对照表
needs.en: Optional: team review guidelines, priority definitions, migration docs and a component owner table

needs.zh-CN: 可选：GitHub、Linear、Greptile 连接器（海外服务，均需密钥）与 Context7、DeepWiki 文档检索（海外服务，无需密钥），用于读取 PR、Issue 与库文档
needs.en: Optional: GitHub, Linear and Greptile connectors (overseas services, credentials required) and Context7 and DeepWiki documentation lookup (overseas services, no credentials) to read PRs, issues and library docs

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件，不运行差异中的代码、测试或脚本
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide for the task and never runs code, tests or scripts from the diff

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认后由你操作：在 PR 或 Issue 上发表评论、批准或请求变更、合并、推送、打标签发版、关闭 Issue 或改标签指派
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation and done by you: commenting on PRs or issues, approving or requesting changes, merging, pushing, tagging releases, closing issues or changing labels and assignees

permissions.zh-CN: 把代码片段上传到外部服务（含代码搜索与文档检索）之前需你确认
permissions.en: Uploading code snippets to external services, including code search and documentation lookup, needs your confirmation

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-26 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：从市场添加、加载到业务、代码评审协作员上岗后，三个任务模板（PR 评审、发布说明、Issue 分诊）按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，每条意见指向文件行号或编号；未在 PR 或 Issue 上发表、未批准合并、未改标签。PR 评审可能比样例更严（如把鉴权缺失列为阻断），结论仍需负责人确认。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-26: added from the market, loaded into a business, code review collaborator on duty; all three templates (PR review, release notes, issue triage) matched the expected structure, each comment traced to a file line or number; nothing was posted, approved, merged or relabelled. PR reviews can be stricter than the sample, so the owner confirms the verdict.

conditions.zh-CN: 代码托管、工单与文档检索连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Code hosting, issue tracker and documentation lookup connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
